arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE corrected transparent mermaid tail sprite. Image1 exact pixel source is absolute SILHOUETTE AND ROLL ANGLE authority. Image2 is prior draft and is MATERIAL ONLY: retain its bright lime/emerald green fin, crisp black contours, simple cel shading, small scale highlights and cyan/white water accents, but replace its incorrect repeated V pose. Source shape is a rolled sideways asymmetric TAIL FLUKE, NOT the upright V from image2. Match first reference outline and orientation literally. LEFT lobe extends broadly toward screen-left and curls sharply UP only at its far-left tip into a short narrow hook. Its lower edge stays low and rounded. RIGHT lobe rises diagonally to UPPER-RIGHT and finishes as a broad tapered tip pointing HORIZONTALLY RIGHT, not a tall upward leaf. The top between lobes has a shallow scoop. The lower outline travels diagonally down-right into a NARROW short stem at the far RIGHT-of-center which drops vertically to water. This is a single broad rolled fin surface, not two separately upright leaves on a centered trunk. Preserve compact rightward-tipped silhouette and strong asymmetry. Sparse white/pale-blue ripple at stem contact only. Smooth cartoon contours rather than stair-stepped pixel edges. Tail only, no torso/person/head, extra fin or ground, no shadows/glow, no text. Actual transparent RGBA, generous clear padding around all tips and ripple marks.
